title: fusion.profile/v1
description: A role's profile, catalog/profiles/<id>/profile.json, the source of both host renders (plan step 5). parts is fusion's own: the renderer concatenates the parts in order, taking neutral parts and the parts tagged for the host it renders, and skipping the other host's; a prior part at a position replaces the claude part at that position. The bundle's profiles/<id>.json carries the other seven keys and nothing else, because Prior decodes it with DisallowUnknownFields and an exact key count (internal/fusionhost/external_catalog.go at 8bab88a); the assembler (plan step 8) drops parts. tools_ceiling, may_delegate and writes_workbench constrain the host's grant and create no permission (Prior answer 67.2); Prior's explorer route refuses an explorer profile with may_delegate true or writes_workbench.prior true. input_schema and result_schema are bundle asset paths under schemas/, resolved inside the verified payload, never through a network reference; the role input is validated against input_schema after the host has added project_context and output_contract, and the domain result against result_schema. Rules JSON Schema cannot check and the catalog tests enforce: id equals the directory name and a catalog entry; every parts file exists; both schema assets exist.

tools_ceiling.description: The tool classes Prior's loader admits (external_catalog.go), each at most once.

execution_policy.description: Fixed per host: Prior enforces the policy itself, Claude Code is guided by the rendered prompt.

schema_asset.description: A bundle asset path: Prior's schema() admits only schemas/<name>.json present in the payload.
